# AP-SOP-04 Update Memo 2026-10

| | |
|---|---|
| Document | AP-SOP-04-U1 |
| Owner | Controller, Finance Operations |
| Effective | 2026-10-01 |

## 1. Change to no-PO categories

1.1 This memo supersedes AP-SOP-04 §8.2. Utilities, taxes and government fees may be paid without a PO and without a three-way match, with AP Manager approval up to $15,000 and the normal limits above that.
